name: petflora
description: PetFlora - API de Plantas Tóxicas e Seguras para Gatos

scripts.setup: cd backend && npm install && npm run parse && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.dev: concurrently "cd backend && npm run dev" "npm run frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.build:backend: cd backend && npm install && npm run parse
scripts.build:frontend: cd frontend && npm install && npm run build
scripts.preview: npm run build && cd frontend && npm run preview
